name: REDATAM
description: REDATAM is statistical software from CELADE/ECLAC for processing, analyzing, and disseminating census, survey, and vital-statistics microdata. National statistics offices publish online catalogs through Redatam Webserver and a REST API for SPC processing jobs.

Nesstar is a legacy microdata and metadata management suite for publishing, browsing, analyzing, and downloading survey and statistical data through Nesstar Repository and WebView, with support for DDI-based metadata workflows.
name: Nesstar

description: NADA (National Data Archive) is an open-source microdata catalog and documentation platform for publishing survey and census metadata with searchable documentation, APIs, and standards-based dissemination workflows.
name: NADA

description: Colectica is a metadata and data documentation platform for statistical, survey, and microdata workflows, supporting standards-based curation, publication, and dissemination through web interfaces and APIs.
name: Colectica

description: Mica is an open-source web platform for discovering, cataloging, and harmonizing epidemiological and population health microdata, providing study metadata management and API-based access for data discovery workflows.
name: Obiba Mica
IPUMS
description: IPUMS is the Integrated Public Use Microdata Series extract and dissemination platform from the University of Minnesota. Harmonized census, survey, and geographic collections (USA, International, CPS, DHS, NHIS, and others) share one extract engine and a REST API for metadata and custom extracts.

Survey Solutions is a World Bank suite for survey data collection and management; the Data Browser provides web access to exported survey microdata and related documentation for authorized dissemination workflows.
name: Survey Solutions

description: Istat Data Browser (ISTAT StatKit) is an open-source SDMX dissemination portal for browsing, visualizing, and downloading aggregate statistics. Installations expose a SPA under /databrowser/ and a hub JSON API (databrowserhub/api/core or databrowser/api/core), often paired with an SDMX-RI web service.
name: Istat Data Browser
TabNet
description: TabNet is a CGI tabulation application from DATASUS (Brazilian Ministry of Health) used to publish cross-tabulations of SUS health databases (SIM, SINASC, SIH, SIA, CNES, SINAN, and related .DBF files). Windows builds use deftohtm.exe and tabcgi.exe; Linux builds use dh and tabnet. Installations are the national DATASUS site plus state and municipal health secretariats and agencies such as ANS.

name: Cancer-Rates.info
description: Cancer-Rates.info is a multi-tenant cancer incidence and mortality query system hosted by the Kentucky Cancer Registry. Central cancer registries publish county maps, tables, and exports at a unique path on cancer-rates.info / cancer-rates.com. Register only public guest UIs, not login-walled tenant paths.

owner.name: Kentucky Cancer Registry, University of Kentucky

name: Data Insight
description: Enterprise data intelligence platform for discovering, classifying, and governing unstructured data at scale.

name: Oracle APEX
description: Oracle APEX is a low-code platform for building data-driven web applications, dashboards, and reporting portals on Oracle Database.
capabilities: REST API - Interactive dashboards - SQL-driven reporting - Low-code app builder

name: Conduent Healthy Communities Institute
description: Conduent Healthy Communities Institute (HCI) is a multi-tenant community health indicator platform used by US counties, hospital systems, and collaboratives for CHNA dashboards. Public standalone sites reuse HCI chrome (Conduent / Healthy Communities Institute in HTML) with local branding such as Health Matters.

PxStat is an open-source statistical dissemination system from Ireland's Central Statistics Office. It publishes multidimensional tables through a web UI and JSON-RPC/REST APIs (JSON-stat, PX, CSV, XLSX). Distinct from Statistics Sweden's PxWeb.
name: PxStat
DataWarehousePro
description: DataWarehousePro is a Wellington-hosted macroeconomic data warehouse used by central banks. Public tenants live at app.datawarehousepro.com/go/{tenant} with guest APIs /guest/getDatabanksWithMnemonics/{tenant} and /guest/export/{tenant}.

name: SDMX-RI
description: SDMX-RI (SDMX Reference Infrastructure) is the SDMX standards-based reference software stack used by statistical organizations to publish and exchange official statistics through interoperable SDMX REST and SOAP interfaces.

name: Data VAVT
description: Data VAVT is an indicators platform for macro- and microeconomic analysis based on statistics from verified domestic and international sources.

SuperSTAR is a confidential statistical dissemination suite from WingArc Australia (formerly Space-Time Research). SuperWEB2 is the browser table-builder client used by statistical agencies to publish census, survey, and administrative cubes with on-the-fly confidentiality.
name: SuperSTAR

description: SDMX-native technology stack and APIs for official statistics portals in the SIS-CC .Stat ecosystem—REST and SDMX services for discovery, structured metadata, and dissemination of indicator data.
name: .Stat Technology
Data.UNICEF.org
description: Data.UNICEF.org is UNICEF's global data and analytics platform that provides indicators, datasets, visualizations, and country profiles focused on child rights and well-being.

name: ILOSTAT
description: ILOSTAT is the International Labour Organization's statistics platform providing global labor market indicators, time series data, and analytical tools for employment, wages, productivity, and related socioeconomic topics.

Knoema is a commercial data discovery and dissemination platform for statistical indicators and time series. It is used to host public and institutional data portals with dataset catalogs, visualizations, downloads, and a REST API.
name: Knoema
Goal Tracker
description: Goal Tracker is Data Act Lab's country SDG visualization platform, developed with the Dag Hammarskjöld Foundation. Country tenants use *.goaltracker.org hosts. Distinct from Open SDG (opensdg) static reporting sites.

name: GENESIS-Online
description: GENESIS-Online is the statistical database software used by the German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) and the statistical offices of the Länder. It disseminates official tables and time series through a shared web catalog, downloads, and web-service interfaces.
.Stat Suite is an open-source, SDMX-native platform for managing the official statistics data lifecycle, including dissemination, metadata handling, and standards-based data exchange.
name: .Stat Suite
DHIS2
description: DHIS2 (District Health Information Software 2) is an open-source health management information system from the HISP Centre at the University of Oslo. National ministries and programmes use it to collect, analyse, and publish routine health indicators, with a REST Web API, analytics endpoints, and optional public portals.

name: IBM Cognos Analytics
description: IBM Cognos Analytics is a business intelligence and analytics platform for creating dashboards, reports, and interactive data visualizations for organizational decision-making.

Beyond 20/20 Web Data Server (WDS) is a proprietary ASP.NET cube browser that publishes multidimensional IVT tables as a public report-folder tree, with interactive table, chart, and map views and per-table downloads (IVT, Excel, CSV).
name: Beyond 20/20 Web Data Server
World Bank Data Platform
description: The World Bank Data platform provides global development indicators, country and regional statistics, and time-series datasets with downloadable files and API access.

name: IBIS-PH
description: IBIS-PH (Indicator-Based Information System for Public Health) is an open-source platform developed by U.S. state health departments to publish indicator reports and run real-time queries against public health datasets. Deployments share XML-driven indicator pages, IBIS-Q query modules, and a community-of-practice codebase.

name: eDatos
description: eDatos is an open-source statistical data and metadata infrastructure started by ISTAC (Canary Islands) and reused by other Spanish regional statistical institutes. Public tenants expose JSON-stat indicator APIs under /indicators/v1.0/ plus e-Cubos / ODS catalog UIs, often on *.edatos.io.

name: DGBAS Web
description: DGBAS Web is Taiwan's local-government statistical query platform (資料庫查詢平臺), distributed by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics under the WINSTA programme. Public tenants use /DgbasWeb/ (index.aspx or Default.aspx) on {org}.dgbas.gov.tw or a municipal host. Distinct from the national nstatdb.dgbas.gov.tw table database and from county PxWeb sites.

owner.name: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics

name: BIS Data Portal
description: The BIS Data Portal provides access to statistical and financial indicators published by the Bank for International Settlements, with interactive exploration and machine-readable SDMX/JSON endpoints for programmatic use.

name: IMF National Summary Data Page
description: The IMF National Summary Data Page (NSDP) is the standardized e-GDDS, SDDS, and SDDS Plus dissemination template that national statistical offices and central banks host. Pages list macroeconomic categories with SDMX 2.0 XML downloads and a link to the IMF Dissemination Standards Bulletin Board. Distinct from Knoema or WordPress sites that only wrap an NSDP.
Apache Superset is an open-source data exploration and visualization platform for building interactive dashboards, charts, and SQL-based analytics over connected datasets.
name: Apache Superset
Swing
description: Swing (ABF Research) is a statistical databank and dashboard platform used by Dutch and Flemish municipalities and provinces. Flemish public tenants live at {city}.incijfers.be and provincies.incijfers.be (Swing Viewer / Swing Jive). Harvest indicator tables, not map tiles.

name: SparkMap
description: SparkMap is a community mapping and assessment platform from the Center for Applied Research and Engagement Systems (CARES) at the University of Missouri. Public Map Room instances expose tens of thousands of indicator layers; branded CARES hubs add community needs assessment reports. A paid REST API provides programmatic access to premium indicators.

owner.name: Center for Applied Research and Engagement Systems, University of Missouri Extension

name: Virtual LMI
description: Virtual LMI (VLMI) is Geographic Solutions’ labor market information module, often hosted at *.virtuallmi.com with a /vosnet/ UI. US state workforce agencies publish LAUS, QCEW, OEWS, projections, and area profiles. Do not label every state LMI site VLMI — confirm virtuallmi.com or /vosnet/.

name: StatPlanet
description: StatPlanet (StatSilk) is interactive mapping and dashboard software for exploring statistical indicators on maps and charts. Public deployments include StatPlanet Cloud (HTML5, data.csv / settings.csv, optional SDMX) and older StatPlanet HTML5/Flash maps. Use this id only for a public indicator explorer, not a vendor demo, a single-map poster, or a viewer of another registered catalog.

name: ECB Data Portal
description: The ECB Data Portal is the European Central Bank's official platform for accessing macroeconomic, financial, and statistical indicators, with support for interactive exploration and SDMX-based data access.

PX-Web is a statistical data dissemination software used to publish and explore multidimensional statistics online, with support for tabular browsing, API access, and standard statistical exchange formats.
name: PxWeb
Eurostat
description: Eurostat is the statistical office of the European Union and provides official European statistics through datasets, indicators, and interactive data access services.

name: FENIX
description: FENIX is FAO's open-source statistical dissemination platform (Dynamic Data Dissemination System / D3S). CountrySTAT national agriculture-statistics portals, FAOSTAT, AMIS, AIDmonitor, and related FAO indicator UIs were built on it. REST APIs are typically on fenixservices.fao.org (for example FAOSTAT /faostat/api/v1/).

owner.name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

description: Open SDG is an open-source platform for publishing Sustainable Development Goal indicators as a web-based reporting portal with data uploads, indicator pages, charts, and downloadable resources.
name: OpenSDG
BI Contour
description: BI Contour is a business intelligence platform for interactive reporting and data analysis. It includes visualization, publishing, and OLAP capabilities and is used to build analytical portals and dashboards for large datasets.

name: WHO Data
description: The World Health Organization data services provide global health indicators, statistics, and monitoring data through web interfaces and APIs for countries and thematic programs.

Semantic MediaWiki is an open-source extension of MediaWiki that enables structured data modeling, semantic annotation, querying, and export from wiki content. It is used to build knowledge-driven data catalogs and portals with machine-readable metadata.
name: Semantic MediaWiki
ATM Maggioli
description: ATM Maggioli (Galileo IyS) Portal de Transparencia is a Spanish municipal electronic-office and open-data catalog used on sede electrónica tenants. Deployments share /transparencia/datos/catalogo dataset listings for local reuse.
Open Data Registry is an open-source metadata registry for publishing and discovering open datasets, with machine-readable catalog files and optional STAC-compatible endpoints.
name: Open Data Registry

description: uData is an open-source data portal platform for publishing and managing datasets, organizations, and resources with a REST API and DCAT-compatible metadata export.
name: uData
Liferay
description: Liferay is an open-source digital experience and content management platform used for government and municipal websites. Spanish provincial deployments expose an Open Data / RISP module that lists reusable municipal datasets as Excel, XML, JSON, and CSV exports.

name: data eye
description: data eye is a Japanese open data portal SaaS from Data Cradle. Prefectures and municipalities use it to register, publish, and share catalogs, including group portals for joint prefecture-municipality publishing and a CKAN-compatible metadata API.

name: OpenAIRE
description: OpenAIRE is a scholarly discovery and monitoring platform built on the OpenAIRE Graph. EXPLORE is the public search interface; CONNECT is a hosted gateway service used for national and community research portals that filter the Graph by organisation, funder, or country.

name: D4Science
description: D4Science is a European digital research infrastructure that provides virtual research environments, data management, and analytics services for collaborative open science workflows across disciplines. It offers integrated tools for data publishing, storage, and processing as a not-for-profit platform.

name: OGD Platform India
description: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India is the National Informatics Centre SaaS used to publish and discover public-sector datasets. Ministries and state governments run dedicated data.gov.in instances with catalog search, downloads, and APIs.

name: oPortal
description: oPortal is a Chinese public-data open-platform product used by provincial and municipal governments. Deployments share an /oportal/ catalog, developer center, data services, and application gallery for publishing government datasets and APIs.
Socrata is a proprietary open data platform for publishing and managing government datasets with catalog search, APIs, and machine-readable metadata exports.
name: Socrata

description: PublishMyData is a linked data publishing platform designed for government and official statistics teams to publish, manage, and serve structured data on the web using semantic web standards and APIs.
name: PublishMyData
ResourceContracts
description: ResourceContracts is NRGI's open-source repository of oil, gas, and mining contracts, also deployed as country portals (for example guinea.resourcecontracts.org). Laravel application with a public contract API.

name: JDOP
description: JDOP is the Zhejiang public-data open platform product. Provincial and municipal deployments share a /jdop_front/ or /dopServer/ catalog (浙江•数据开放) used by Zhejiang province, Hangzhou, Wenzhou, and Jinhua for publishing government datasets and APIs.

name: Our Open Data
description: Our Open Data is the Japanese open-data catalog UI of the SHIRASAGI CMS (ss-proj.org), used by Tokushima, Kagawa, Aomori, Tottori, Shizuoka, Ehime, and Kakegawa. Deployments share /assets/cms/public.css, jPlayer, numeric /dataset/{n}.html pages, a three-part layout of data catalog, application market, and idea box, and a SHIRASAGI /api/package_list API. Distinct from CKAN (/api/3/action/status_show) and data.go.jp.

name: Guangxi Public Data Open Platform
description: The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region public data open platform hosts the provincial catalog at data.gxzf.gov.cn and city tenants at {city}.data.gxzf.gov.cn. Custom stack (not CKAN) built for five-level public-data opening. One record per tenant, not per dataset.

owner.name: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Big Data Development Bureau

description: WordPress is an open-source content management system widely used to build websites, including open data portals via custom themes, plugins, and API-driven integrations.
name: WordPress
SEU-e
description: SEU-e is the Consorci AOC electronic office, transparency, and open data service for Catalan public administrations. Municipalities publish shared open-data pages under seu-e.cat with common dataset listings for local reuse.

name: OpenGDC
description: OpenGDC is an open-source Dutch municipal data catalog (Drupal / Dexes) for datasets, APIs, and Wet open overheid dossiers. It publishes DCAT-AP metadata and a JSON:API catalog, and registers with data.overheid.nl. Distinct from the genomic OpenGDC extraction tool.

Tablion Data Portal is a commercial open data portal product by Aristotle Metadata that supports publishing, discovery, and metadata exchange for datasets through web interfaces and standards-based exports.
name: Tablion
CKAN
description: CKAN is an open-source data management system for publishing, sharing, and using data. It powers hundreds of public open data portals and internal data hubs with datasets, organizations, resources, a rich Action API, and an extensible plugin ecosystem (including DCAT and OAI-PMH).

Strapi is an open-source headless CMS platform used to model, manage, and deliver structured content and data through customizable APIs. It supports flexible content types, role-based access control, and extensible integrations for public sector and open data publishing workflows.
name: Strapi
Seoul Open Data Plaza
description: Seoul Open Data Plaza is the shared open-data catalog used by Seoul Metropolitan Government district (gu) portals. Tenant sites share /openinf/ JSP pages, the jachigu theme, dataset listings, and Open API developer space, with titles of the form 열린 데이터 광장.

name: LKOD
description: LKOD (Lokální katalog otevřených dat) is an open-source local open-data catalog from Golemio / Operátor ICT. It implements DCAT-AP-CZ, harvests into the Czech National Open Data Catalog (NKOD), and is deployed as Next.js catalogs on lkod.cz or self-hosted instances for Czech public bodies.

JKAN is an open-source, lightweight data catalog platform built on Jekyll for publishing open datasets as static sites. It focuses on simple deployment, CKAN-style metadata patterns, and optional API compatibility for small and medium open data portals.
name: JKAN

description: Magda is an open-source data catalog and discovery platform for publishing, searching, and reusing open data. It provides configurable dataset metadata, organization support, and API-driven integrations for government and institutional data portals.

owner.name: Queensland Government Customer and Digital Group

name: Magda

description: OpenDataSoft is a software platform for publishing, managing, and sharing open data portals with dataset cataloging, APIs, and data visualization features for public and private organizations.
name: OpenDataSoft

description: Drupal is an open-source content management framework used to build and manage websites, including open data portals through dedicated modules, metadata extensions, and API integrations.
name: Drupal
POMOSAM
description: POMOSAM (CG eGOV) is a municipal eGovernment and open data publishing platform by CORA GEO, focused on publishing public city information, contracts, invoices, orders, and enabling citizen online communication with local administration.

name: Gipuzkoa Irekia
description: Gipuzkoa Irekia is the Provincial Council of Gipuzkoa's shared open government and open data platform. Municipalities and foral entities publish datasets on tenant sites with a common catalog, DCAT feeds, and open-data search.

name: data.gov.my
description: data.gov.my is Malaysia's national open data portal for publishing and discovering public-sector datasets across government domains. It provides dataset search and API-enabled access to structured data resources for reuse by citizens, researchers, and businesses.

owner.name: Malaysian Administrative Modernisation and Management Planning Unit (MAMPU)

name: Idra
description: Idra is an open-source Open Data Federation Platform from Engineering Ingegneria Informatica (FIWARE). It harvests heterogeneous ODMS catalogues (CKAN, DKAN, Socrata, OpenDataSoft, NGSI, DCAT-AP dumps, and scraped sites), harmonizes metadata to DCAT-AP / DCAT-AP_IT, and exposes a search portal, REST API, and SPARQL endpoint.

name: MODA Open Data Platform
description: MODA Open Data Platform is the open-source Nuxt/Vue frontend for Taiwan's government open-data catalogs. The Ministry of Digital Affairs publishes moda-gov-tw/opendata-frontend; national data.gov.tw and local platforms such as New Taipei and Taipei reuse the same _nuxt stack and catalog API.

1C-Bitrix is a commercial web content management and portal platform used to build government and enterprise websites, including open data publication pages and catalog sections. It provides extensible modules, role-based administration, and API integration capabilities for publishing structured content and datasets.
name: Bitrix
RDF Online Repository
description: The Online Repository is Revenue Development Foundation's public transparency portal for mining and other license registries. Country tenants are hosted on *.revenuedev.org and publish from MCAS/xCAS via the RDx REST exchange. Distinct from W3C RDF.
Datawheel is a data platform provider focused on open data portals, economic complexity analytics, and AI-powered data tools for governments and international organizations.
name: DataWheel

description: Data Fair is an open-source data platform for managing, visualizing, exploring, and sharing datasets through configurable portals, interactive views, and API-based access.
name: Data Fair

description: TriplyDB is a linked-data and knowledge graph publishing platform used to host, query, and share datasets through SPARQL endpoints, APIs, and reusable data services.
name: TriplyDB

description: Aleph is an open-source investigative data platform for indexing, searching, and cross-referencing large collections of documents and structured datasets. It is designed for investigative journalism workflows and entity-centric research across people, companies, and related records.

owner.name: OCCRP (Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project)

name: Aleph
OpenGov
description: OpenGov (Tyler Technologies) is a US local-government financial transparency SaaS. Public tenants use {org}.opengov.com with /transparency and /data report views. Distinct from generic sites named OpenGov, wyopen.gov checkbooks, and ArcGIS Hub portals branded as open government.
Junar is a proprietary open data platform for publishing, managing, and sharing datasets through catalog interfaces and APIs for government and enterprise data programs.
name: Junar

description: EntryScape is a linked-data-based information management platform for publishing and managing open data catalogs across the full metadata lifecycle, with strong support for DCAT-AP standards.
name: EntryScape
Copernicus Data Stores
description: Copernicus Data Stores is the ECMWF catalog and retrieve platform used by the Climate Data Store, Atmosphere Data Store, and CEMS Early Warning Data Store. Users search quality-assured climate, atmosphere, and emergency datasets in the web catalog and download them through the CDS API.

owner.name: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)

description: DKAN is an open-source data management and catalog platform built on Drupal for publishing, discovering, and reusing open data. It supports dataset metadata, organizations, APIs, and standards-based exports for government and institutional open data portals.
name: DKAN
ODWeb
description: ODWeb is a Chinese municipal and provincial public-data open catalog product that serves the catalog under an /odweb/ path (scripts, skins, and dataset listing). Independent hosts include Changzhi, Jiangmen, and Henan. Distinct from Inspur oPortal (`oportal`) and Zhejiang JDOP (`jdop`).

Piveau is an open-source metadata catalogue platform for public-sector open data portals. It is built around DCAT and DCAT-AP, with a microservice architecture covering harvesting, RDF storage, search, quality metrics, and a customizable catalog UI. It powers portals such as data.europa.eu.
name: Piveau

description: DataPress is a managed open data portal platform used by public sector organizations, combining CKAN-based data catalog functionality with portal publishing and content management features.
name: DataPress
K5 MapServer
description: K5 MapServer (K5MapServer) is MK Consult's municipal web geoportal for Kompas 5. Tenants live at {muni}.k5mapserver.cz with title GEOPORTÁL and shared /core/Page.js. Distinct from UMN MapServer (mapserver) and from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: InfoGIS
description: InfoGIS is Infokartta Oy's Finnish municipal map SaaS. Public tenants live at www.infogis.fi/{municipality}/ with title InfoGIS, scripts under /codebase-infogis/, OpenLayers, and meta author Infokartta Oy. Distinct from Sitowise Louhi (louhi) and Trimble Locus IMS (trimblelocus). One record per municipality path tenant.

name: Data Library
description: Data Library is a geospatial and climate-focused data portal platform used to publish map-based datasets and interactive maproom views. It supports browsing and discovery of gridded and tabular data, provides downloadable data outputs in common geospatial formats, and is commonly used by meteorological and climate information services.

owner.name: International Research Institute for Climate and Society (IRI), Columbia University

name: giscity
description: giscity is ibb DV-Systems' browser municipal GIS. Hosted public tenants live at www.gisserver.de/{city}/ and load portal.js with GIScity Service Hosting credits. Distinct from US gis.cityof* ArcGIS catalogs and from ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub).

name: Masterportal
description: Masterportal is an open-source web geoportal developed by Hamburg's Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung and used by German federal, state, and municipal agencies. It provides OGC-based map viewers (WMS, WFS, CSW, WPS) for spatial data infrastructures.

name: Weave
description: Weave is Cohga's HTML5 municipal web GIS used by Australian local government. Public council maps use HTML title Weave Map and a webpack app.*.js client. Distinct from IntraMaps Public (intramaps), Exponare (exponare), Pozi (pozi), and Spectrum Spatial Analyst (spectrumspatial). Do not set weave from GeneWeaver or other hosts that merely contain the word weave.

name: GeDA-Public
description: GeDA-Public is Nakano AI System's public WebGIS (住民公開GIS), hosted on geogeo.jp tenant hostnames such as {city}.geogeo.jp and {city}.e-map.geogeo.jp. It publishes municipal map galleries transferred from the internal GeDA integrated GIS. Distinct from GeDA itself, which is staff-only.

OpenWIS is an open-source metadata catalog and data discovery platform designed for meteorological and geospatial information exchange. It provides cataloging, search, and standards-based interoperability features used in weather and climate data infrastructures.
name: OpenWIS
CommunityView
description: CommunityView is Digital Map Products (LightBox) municipal web GIS. Public city tenants live at maps.digitalmapcentral.com/production/VECommunityView/cities/{city}/ with HTML title CommunityView and Powered By Digital Map Products. Distinct from ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps) and Bing Maps controls used only as a basemap. Do not register the vendor marketing homepage.

name: GET SDI Portal
description: GET SDI Portal is an open-source spatial data infrastructure client from Geospatial Enabling Technologies. It publishes a tabbed geoportal (map, metadata, files, and services) over GeoServer and GeoNetwork, exposing OGC WMS, WFS, WCS, and CSW to municipal and regional SDIs, especially in Greece.

name: Spatial Suite
description: Spatial Suite (public client SpatialMap) is Sweco's web GIS used by Danish municipalities and utilities. Public webkort viewers load /js/standard/browserdetect.js with a SpatialMap version query. Distinct from NIRAS KortInfo.

name: GeoMapFish
description: GeoMapFish is an open-source WebGIS geoportal platform. The c2cgeoportal Python backend and ngeo client publish OGC services (WMS, WFS, WMTS), theme-based map viewers, and access control. It is widely used by Swiss cantons and other European public-sector geoportals.

name: GIS WebServer SE
description: GIS WebServer SE is a web GIS platform for building geoportals and publishing spatial data services. It is designed for map visualization, layer management, and integration of geospatial resources through web interfaces and standards-based services.

name: GisMaster
description: GisMaster is Technical Design S.r.l. municipal Web GIS used by Italian comuni. Public GeoPortale tenants live on geoportale.sportellounicodigitale.it/GisMaster with an IdCliente (ISTAT comune code or TD* client id). VisualDesc.aspx / VisualDescNR.aspx is the catalog landing; Default.aspx is the same tenant map, not a second catalog. Distinct from GISApp (gisapp), Masterportal (masterportal), and MapGIS IGServer (mapgisigserver). Skip cemetery VisualCim-only totems and empty boilerplate tenants with no cadastre/PRGC layers.

name: SmartMap
description: SmartMap is a hosted Kazakh district investment geoportal. Public tenants live at {district}.smartmap.kz and share a Leaflet plus Google Maps viewer (stylse.css). Used by West Kazakhstan akimats for land plots, mineral occurrences, and infrastructure map objects. Distinct from Geonomics (geonomics) regional portals and from unrelated SMARTMap finance products.

name: Geocortex Essentials
description: Geocortex Essentials (now VertiGIS Studio) is a commercial web GIS that extends Esri ArcGIS with configurable sites and the Geocortex Viewer for HTML5. Public geoportals typically expose a Geocortex Essentials REST Sites Directory (often /Geocortex/Essentials/REST/sites, ?f=pjson) and/or an Html5Viewer titled Geocortex Viewer for HTML5. Hosted tenants appear under *.geocortex.com. Distinct from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice) and VertiGIS Studio Web (vertigisstudioweb).

GeoPortal.rlp is an open-source SDI suite for managing and publishing geospatial services and metadata, including OWS endpoints (WMS, WFS, CSW), ISO 19139 metadata workflows, map viewers, and organizational access controls. It is developed by the mrmap-community for deployments such as Geoportal Rheinland-Pfalz.
name: GeoPortal.rlp
VertiGIS WebOffice
description: VertiGIS WebOffice (formerly SynerGIS WebOffice) is a commercial web GIS that extends Esri ArcGIS Enterprise with configurable map clients. Public geoportals typically expose a /synserver (or /WebOffice/synserver) application titled VertiGIS WebOffice, often with weboffice_packed.css and core, flex, or mobile clients. Multi-tenant hosting appears under wo-hosting.vertigis.com and map.geoportal.at. Distinct from Geocortex Essentials (geocortex) and VertiGIS Studio Web (vertigisstudioweb).

name: PAGIS
description: PAGIS is GeneGIS GI's hosted municipal SIT / WebGIS used by Italian comuni. Tenants live at {comune}.servizigis.it (Index.aspx) and on city-owned hosts such as sit.comune.benevento.it. Distinct from Pulaski Area GIS (www.pagis.org, arcgisserver) and from Emilia-Romagna ArcGIS hosts named servizigis.*. Skip the vendor marketing hubs services.servizigis.it and pagis.it. One record per municipality, not IndexPC.aspx as a second copy of the same SIT when Index.aspx is the public catalog.

name: GP Atlas
description: GP Atlas (геоинформационная платформа «Атлас») is a web GIS from the Territorial Information Fund of the Komi Republic for publishing interactive maps, searching and analyzing spatial data, and managing user access. Public catalogs include the Komi geoportal (gis.rkomi.ru), the Kirov Oblast geoportal (gis.geokirov.ru), and the Arkhangelsk forest-dispatcher Atlas (fires.dvinaland.ru).

owner.name: Territorial Information Fund of the Komi Republic

name: Mapbender
description: Mapbender is an open-source geospatial web framework and geoportal solution for building map applications on top of OGC services and spatial data infrastructures. It provides configurable map viewers, search and editing tools, user and role management, and integrations for publishing and consuming geospatial resources in government and enterprise environments.

name: Tobel
description: Tobel municipal GIS is a Bulgarian Web GIS used by cities and districts for cadastral, urban-planning, and local map layers. Public tenants live at {city}.tobel.bg (and related hosts such as shumenweb.tobel.bg).

name: Geolonia スマートマップ
description: Geolonia 公開型GIS「スマートマップ」 is a Digital Agency model-spec public WebGIS for Japanese local governments. Multi-tenant brands include とっとりジオマップ on {org}.tottori-geomap.jp and 香川県 公開型GIS -BRIDGES-. Viewers are Next.js apps with Geolonia vector basemaps. Distinct from Kazakhstan SmartMap (smartmap).

name: Tianditu
description: Tianditu (Map World) is China's National Geographic Information Public Service Platform. National, provincial, and municipal nodes share a common architecture, APIs, and branding for authoritative online maps, geocoding, and geospatial data services operated under NGCC technical standards.

name: MangoMap
description: MangoMap is a hosted web-mapping SaaS for publishing interactive map galleries and geospatial datasets. Organization portals are served from mangomap.com tenant URLs.

name: touvia.MAPS
description: touvia.MAPS is vianovis GmbH's hosted municipal web GIS (touvia.geoCMS plus Cesium viewer). Public tenants live at vianovis.net/{tenant}/ or a city host that loads touvia.de/scripts/loader.js and loadTouviaMaps(). Distinct from Hamburg Masterportal (masterportal) even when vianovis also hosts touvia.MASTERPORTAL.

name: SonicWeb
description: SonicWeb (SonicWeb-Cloud) is Kokusai Kogyo's hosted public WebGIS for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Public tenants live under www.sonicweb-asp.jp/{slug}/ and load sonicweb.js. Distinct from the internal SonicWeb-i / SonicWeb-EXT integrated GIS.

name: Sampaş WebGIS
description: Sampaş WebGIS is the municipal city-guide map in Sampaş Bilişim's AKOS (Akıllı Kent Otomasyon Sistemi) suite. Public instances are typically published at /KentrehberiApp/Index and title the page with SAMPAŞ WEBGIS.

name: deegree
description: deegree is an open-source Java framework for spatial data infrastructures and OGC web services. It provides reference implementations of WMS, WFS, WMTS, CSW and WPS, plus deegree ogcapi for OGC API Features, and is widely used for INSPIRE-compliant geospatial service stacks.

name: MS-GIS
description: MS-GIS is a Lower Austria municipal GeoInformation viewer hosted at {city}.msgis.net with HTML title {City} GeoInformation. Distinct from Masterportal (masterportal), touvia.MAPS (touviamaps), and VC Map (vcmap). Do not register the marketing homepage.

name: Spectrum Spatial Analyst
description: Spectrum Spatial Analyst is Precisely's (formerly Pitney Bowes / MapInfo) browser GIS used by councils and regional bodies as a public map catalog. It supersedes Exponare. Public sites use path /connect/analyst/ or /connect/analyst/mobile/, HTML title Spectrum Spatial (sometimes a local brand), Precisely favicon assets, and mapcfg= project parameters. Distinct from Exponare (/exponare/), IntraMaps, ArcGIS Hub/REST, and Experience Builder on the same owner.

name: CTMGEO SigWEB
description: CTMGEO SigWEB is a Brazilian municipal cadastral WebGIS hosted at {city}.ctmgeo.com.br/mapa/. Public tenants share title SIGWeb and a cadastral lot map. Distinct from unrelated municipal sites that reuse the generic SIGWeb label on other vendors or .gov.br hosts.

name: ISY Map
description: ISY Map is Norconsult Digital's municipal web GIS (also ISY Map Server and GeoInnsyn). Public viewers use /geoinnsyn/ or /webkart/, titles ISYMap or ISY Map Server, and often hosts on *.isy.no. Distinct from Avinet Adaptive (avinet) county atlases and from ArcGIS Hub on nordlandsatlas.nfk.no.

name: Astun iShare
description: Astun iShare is a UK local-government enterprise GIS and public mapping portal (iShare Maps, My Maps, My House / Find my nearest), often hosted as iShare in the Cloud. Public viewers typically show “Powered by iShare” and ASP.NET paths such as /mymaps.aspx. Distinct from the INDEPTH iShare microdata catalog and from Cadcorp SIS WebMap (cadcorp).

name: Cadcorp SIS WebMap
description: Cadcorp SIS WebMap (backed by GeognoSIS) is a commercial web GIS used by UK and other local authorities as the public map portal. Public sites are typically branded SIS WebMap or Web Map Layers. Distinct from disy Cadenza (cadenza) and from Astun iShare (ishare). Vendor is now NEC Software Solutions UK.

name: Sentinel Hub
description: Sentinel Hub (Sinergise / Planet) is a commercial Earth-observation platform with a STAC Catalog API, OGC WMS/WMTS/WCS, Process API, and EO Browser / Copernicus Browser clients. Official catalog hosts include services.sentinel-hub.com and collections.sentinel-hub.com. Prefer sentinelhub over stacserver for Sentinel Hub Catalog. Distinct from openEO backends (openeo), including the Sentinel Hub openEO API on Copernicus Data Space.

name: eKMap Cloud
description: eKMap Cloud is eKGIS's Vietnamese provincial planning GIS. Public viewers share Mapbox GL JS 1.13, `assets/ekmapboxgl/ekmap-mapboxgl.js`, `assets/ekmapboxgl/common.js`, and mapbox-gl-compare, often with title `eKMap Cloud`. Distinct from Hanoi `quyhoach.hanoi.gov.vn` (Next.js, not eKMap), Vinh Phuc OpenLayers 6 planning maps, and HCMC VLAB Leaflet planning. Do not set ekmap from a site that only loads Mapbox GL without the ekmapboxgl assets.

name: わが街ガイド
description: わが街ガイド (Wagmap) is PASCO's hosted public WebGIS for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Tenants publish map galleries and, on many sites, an open-data catalog. Installations run on www2.wagmap.jp or a custom domain and load GeoAccessJS portal assets.

name: MapProxy
description: MapProxy is an open source proxy and cache for map services that accelerates and unifies access to geospatial data sources. It aggregates, tiles, and republishes map content from OGC and web map services through configurable WMS, WMTS, and TMS endpoints for geoportal and GIS applications.

name: Geodeticca WEB GIS
description: Geodeticca WEB GIS is GEODETICCA VISION's municipal map client. Public tenants live at gis.{city}.sk, title the page Geodeticca WEB GIS, and load /js/config.js plus /js/build/libs.js. Distinct from CORA GEO CG WebGIS (cgwebgis) and T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: ncWMS
description: ncWMS is an open-source web map service for serving NetCDF and other multidimensional environmental data as dynamic map layers. It provides OGC WMS support for scientific and meteorological datasets, enabling rendering, styling, and extraction workflows for geospatial portals and clients.

owner.name: Reading e-Science Centre, University of Reading

name: EverGIS
description: EverGIS (ЭверГИС) is a web GIS platform from Everpoint for creating, editing, and publishing maps, layers, and spatial tables. It is available as free hosted EverGIS Online and as an on-premises server, with a REST API and OGC publication (WMS, WFS, WMTS).

NextGIS Web is an open-source geospatial platform for publishing, managing, and editing spatial data through a web interface. It supports vector and raster layers, web maps, user access control, and integration via REST and OGC-compatible services.
name: NextGIS Web

description: pycsw is an open source OGC API - Records and CSW server implementation for publishing and searching geospatial metadata. It supports standards-based discovery, harvesting, and catalog interoperability for spatial data infrastructures and geoportals.
name: pycsw
MapStore
description: MapStore (MapStore2) is an open-source web GIS framework from GeoSolutions for building geoportals and map viewers. It provides catalog search, map composition, and integration with GeoServer and other OGC services (WMS, WFS, WMTS, CSW).

ERDAS APOLLO is an enterprise geospatial content management and dissemination platform from Hexagon. It is used to catalog, govern, and publish raster and vector geospatial data and services, with support for metadata-driven discovery and OGC-compliant web service delivery in spatial data infrastructure deployments.
name: ERDAS APOLLO

description: hale»connect is wetransform's data-infrastructure platform for transforming, validating, and publishing INSPIRE, XPlanung, and other OGC datasets. Public clouds and on-prem tenants expose CSW (often pycsw-backed), WMS, WFS, and OGC API services. Register the public catalog UI or CSW root, not the bundled pycsw as a separate product.
name: hale»connect
CG WebGIS
description: CG WebGIS is CORA GEO's municipal geographic web portal (WebGIS v2). Public tenants live at webgis.{city}.sk or a city host that still loads the jQuery 1.10 / tabSlideOut client and titles the page WebGIS v2, CG or WebGIS {city}. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan).

name: SOFTPRO
description: SOFTPRO Містобудівний кадастр is a Ukrainian urban-planning cadastre GIS. Public tenants live at {city}.cadastre.com.ua or city MBK hosts and mention SOFTPRO in the page, with either a Tailwind /assets/index-*.js geoportal or the older /js/locale/ua.js plus /assets/image/intro-icon.svg client. Distinct from the state Urban Planning Cadastre (kadastr.gov.ua) and from StateGeoCadastre map.land.gov.ua.

name: NOL-IS
description: NOL-IS is a commercial municipal WebGIS and geoportal platform used by German local governments to publish maps, geodata, and related services. Deployments commonly load viewer assets from maps.nol-is.de or static.nol-is.de.

name: Isogeo
description: Isogeo is a French SaaS catalog for GIS metadata (OpenCatalog and App). Public portals expose an OpenAPI at /api and a searchable inventory of ISO 19115 datasets, often with CSW. Distinct from IsiGéo (isigeo), the Geomatika geoportal product.

name: terGIS
description: terGIS is a Latvian territorial-planning and public-engagement GIS (METRUM / TOPO DATI) hosted on {tenant}.tergis.lv. Municipal tenants use an Angular SPA with a public /api/v1/classifiers/layers catalog; some territorial-plan viewers use a QWC2 frontend on the same domain. Distinct from generic QWC2 (qwc2) off tergis.lv and from the sibling pGIS (pgis.lv) product.

name: GeoBlacklight
description: GeoBlacklight is an open-source geospatial discovery platform built on Blacklight and Apache Solr. It offers map-based and keyword search, faceted browsing, customizable metadata (including OpenGeoMetadata and the GeoBlacklight schema), and download and export options for maps and datasets. It is developed as a multi-institutional collaboration; the software is copyright Stanford University and licensed under Apache 2.0.

Koordinates is a cloud-native geospatial data platform used by governments, utilities, and private organizations to publish, manage, discover, and share spatial datasets. It supports enterprise data governance workflows, metadata management, and open-data publication with built-in APIs and OGC services for integration with GIS and analytics ecosystems.
name: Koordinates
VKOMAP
description: VKOMAP is Geoinfo's municipal and regional geoportal for Kazakh akimats. Public tenants share Leaflet plus Esri assets under /vkomap/, language paths such as /Kaz, and JSON APIs at /Public/GetKatoList and /Public/GetLayers. Distinct from Geonomics (Vue/Mapbox akimat portals) and from SmartMap district investment sites.

name: disy Cadenza
description: disy Cadenza is a commercial data analytics, reporting, and GIS platform from Disy Informationssysteme. German public-sector geoportals typically expose Cadenza Web or Cadenza Workbooks as a browser catalog of maps, tables, charts, and dashboards. Classic installs use JSF paths such as /cadenza/, /public/, or /pages/map/; Workbooks installs use a navigator of workbooks. Page fingerprints include cadenza in HTML/JS, disy branding, and often a guest login before the public theme tree.

name: KortInfo
description: KortInfo is NIRAS' hosted web GIS used by Danish municipalities and utilities. Public citizen maps run on drift.kortinfo.net/Map.aspx with a Site tenant and page such as Borgersite or kortHjemmeside. Distinct from Sweco Spatial Suite (spatialsuite).

name: JMap
description: JMap is K2 Geospatial's map-based integration platform (JMap Web and JMap NG). Public catalogs use /JMapWeb/ with jmap.min.js, JMap NG /services/ng/ loading jmapserver-ng, or hosted tenants on *.jmaponline.net. Distinct from ArcGIS viewers and from hostnames that merely contain "jmap" (Gyeongju gjmap, Rutgers NJMaps). Do not register JMap Admin login.

name: VC Map
description: VC Map is Virtual City Systems' open-source 2D/3D web GIS (OpenLayers plus Cesium). Public digital-twin and city-model apps use html.vcs-ui, title VC Map, and load ./assets/start.js, including tenants on virtualcitymap.de. Distinct from Hamburg Masterportal (masterportal) and vianovis touvia.MAPS (touviamaps).

name: ALANDIS+
description: ALANDIS+ is Asia Air Survey's hosted public WebGIS (公開型GIS) for Japanese prefectures and municipalities. Public tenants commonly live under webgis.alandis.jp/{tenant}/ and load autologin_jswebgis. Distinct from staff-only ALANDIS NEO / LGWAN integrated GIS.

SuperMap iServer is an enterprise geospatial server platform for publishing, managing, and sharing spatial data and GIS services. It provides RESTful and OGC service interfaces for map visualization, feature access, raster coverage, and integration into web and desktop geospatial applications.
name: SuperMap iServer
Re:Earth
description: Re:Earth is an open-source WebGIS for building 3D digital-twin and map applications on Cesium. Japan's Project PLATEAU VIEW (2.0 and later) is built on Re:Earth and publishes catalog and CityGML APIs.

name: GeoMedia SmartClient Public Maps
description: GIS Quadrat PublicMaps is a Hexagon GeoMedia SmartClient public viewer. Municipal tenants live at publicmaps.gisquadrat.com/BP/WEPM.aspx with site=GMSC and a per-town project= slug, sharing title GeoMedia SmartClient Public Maps and ig.publicmaps.application.min.js. Distinct from GeoMedia WebMap Geospatial Portal (geomediawebmap) and from GIS Quadrat ERDAS APOLLO on apollo.gisquadrat.com. Do not register the marketing homepage. Skip the retired gis-klagenfurt.at host replaced by Klagenfurt's HxDR digital twin.

name: iObčina
description: iObčina (Croatian iOpćina) is Kaliopa's cloud municipal GIS. Public viewers use ASP.NET /gisapp/Default.aspx?a={tenant} on gis.iobcina.si and iopcina.hr. Distinct from Romanian GISApp (gisapp) on gisapp.ro and from EQWC.

name: PISO
description: PISO (Prostorski informacijski sistem občin) is Realis's municipal GIS for Slovenia. The public hub at geoprostor.net / PisoPortal covers 150+ municipalities with cadastral, planning, and infrastructure layers and publishes OGC services for QGIS/ArcGIS. Distinct from Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina).

Oskari is an open-source geospatial platform and framework for building national and local geoportals. It provides map publishing, spatial data visualization, and integration capabilities through configurable APIs and OGC-compatible services.
name: Oskari
MAP+
description: MAP+ is TYDAC AG's modular WebGIS. Public city maps load /mapplus-lib/ and OpenLayers, often with tydac branding. Used by Swiss municipalities (Chur, St. Gallen, Biel, geoJura bernois) and sold in Germany as GeoAS Web. Distinct from GeoMapFish (geomapfish) and from mf-geoadmin3 (mfgeoadmin3).

name: openEO
description: openEO is an open API and ecosystem for cloud-native Earth observation processing. Backends expose a JSON landing page with api_version, STAC-compatible /collections, and /processes for process graphs. Used by Copernicus Data Space, VITO, EODC, mundialis Actinia, and other EO platforms.

name: gvSIG Online
description: gvSIG Online is an open-source web platform for building spatial data infrastructures and municipal geoportals. It provides an administration UI for publishing layers, defining symbology, creating map viewers, and managing permissions, and integrates GeoServer (required) and optionally GeoNetwork for OGC services and metadata cataloguing. It is developed by the gvSIG Association and Scolab and is licensed under the Affero GPL.

name: MxSIG
description: MxSIG is INEGI's open-source web GIS (Mapa Digital de México V6). Public viewers load /mdm6/ or /mxsig2/ with jquery 1.9, amplify.js, lz-string, and title Mapa Digital de México. Distinct from OVIE (ovie), which is a separate OpenLayers/Materialize economic template. Do not set mxsig from a generic OpenLayers copy or from Gaia DENUE wrapper pages that are not the MDM6 viewer.

name: IntraMaps Public
description: IntraMaps Public is TechnologyOne Spatial's municipal web GIS used by Australian and New Zealand councils. Public maps use title IntraMaps, ApplicationEngine frontend assets (poweredByLogo.png), project=Public query parameters, on-prem paths such as /intramaps90/default.htm, and TechnologyOne Cloud tenants at {council}.spatial.t1cloud.com/spatial/intramaps/. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub/REST on the same council and from TechnologyOne eProperty.

MapGIS IGServer is Zondy Cyber's enterprise GIS server for publishing, managing, and sharing spatial data. .NET (often port 6163) and Java (often port 8089) editions expose a REST catalog under /igs/rest/ plus OGC WMS, WFS, WMTS, WCS, and CSW. IGS 1.0 lists map documents at /igs/rest/mrcs/docs; IGS 2.0 lists services at /igs/rest/services.
name: MapGIS IGServer

description: Lizmap is an open-source web GIS and geoportal platform built on QGIS Server for publishing, discovering, and sharing geospatial datasets, maps, and services. It supports standards-based interoperable geodata access and provides web and mobile clients for map viewing, search, and thematic exploration.
name: Lizmap
Palapa
description: Palapa (Geoportal Palapa / GSPalapa) is Badan Informasi Geospasial's open-source simpul jaringan geoportal for Indonesian ministries, provinces, and kabupaten/kota. Public nodes use title Geoportal Palapa, path /main/, login /gspalapa/, and a bundled GeoServer plus pycsw CSW at /csw. Distinct from GeoNode, standalone GeoServer catalogs, Ina-Geoportal, provincial /WebPortal/ shells, and CKAN hosts branded Satu Data Palapa.

MetaGIS is a geospatial data management and map publishing platform used to build geoportals and spatial data infrastructures. It focuses on managing metadata, publishing map services, and delivering web-based geographic discovery and visualization workflows for public-sector and research users.
name: Metagis
smart.finder SDI
description: smart.finder SDI is a geospatial discovery and metadata portal platform by con terra for building spatial data infrastructures. It supports catalog-based search, metadata management, and integration with OGC and API-driven geospatial services used by public-sector geoportals.

name: GiSoftGis
description: GiSoftGis is a municipal web GIS and city-guide product from GiSoft Bilgi Teknolojileri. Public city-guide apps are Angular SPAs at /GiSoftGis/#/cityguidepublic, with a gi-ajax-loading-indicator shell and the meta description Kent Rehberi Uygulaması.

name: GeoNode
description: GeoNode is an open-source platform for building spatial data infrastructures and geospatial data portals. It combines cataloging, search, metadata management, map composition, access control, and publishing workflows, and exposes data through OGC services and REST APIs. GeoNode is developed by an international open-source community and supported within the OSGeo ecosystem.

name: QGIS Server
description: QGIS Server is the OGC map and feature server bundled with QGIS. It publishes QGIS projects as WMS, WFS, WCS, and OGC API services (typical CGI/FastCGI path qgis_mapserv.fcgi, often with MAP=.qgs). Register it when QGIS Server is the public catalog. Do not add a second record when Lizmap, QWC2, or mviewer on the same host is the public product.

name: Loftmyndir
description: Loftmyndir Kortasjá is a hosted Icelandic municipal map viewer. Public tenants share www.map.is/{municipality}/ with Loftmyndir branding. Distinct from Alta Vefsjá (alta) on geo.alta.is and from other Icelandic kortasjá sites that are not Loftmyndir.

name: Hajk
description: Hajk is an open-source React, Material UI, and OpenLayers web GIS developed in Sweden. Municipal and agency public maps load appConfig.json with mapserviceBase pointing at /api/v1, /api/v2, or /mapservice. Distinct from Spatial Suite (spatialsuite) and GeoServer backends on the same estate.

name: SeaSketch
description: SeaSketch is UCSB/NCEAS hosted marine spatial planning software. Public project map portals live at www.seasketch.org/{project}/app (title SeaSketch). Sketch editing often needs an account; overlay layers may be public. Distinct from ArcGIS REST on data.seasketch.org (arcgisserver). Do not register the marketing homepage as a catalog.

name: GeoNube
description: GeoNube is Cooperativa Cambalache's hosted Leaflet/bootleaf map platform for Argentine municipalities and organisations. Public tenants use geonube.com.ar/visor/{slug} or a custom domain that embeds those visors. Distinct from unrelated municipal IDEs that do not load GeoNube bootleaf assets.

name: Geoportál GEPRO
description: Geoportál GEPRO is GEPRO's municipal web GIS (OpenLayers client under /OUT/HTML/) used by Czech towns and ORP. Tenants live at {city}.obce.gepro.cz or {city}.gepro.cz. Distinct from desktop MISYS and from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) on gis4u.cz.

name: Marushka
description: Marushka is GEOVAP's map application server (.NET / GSFrameWork) used by Czech cities. Public HTML clients load zipped.js with title “Marushka - Mapový aplikační server” or a Blazor shell with js/marushka.js. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) and Geoportál GEPRO (gepro).

ORBISMap is a geospatial platform for publishing, managing, and visualizing spatial data in web geoportals and regional GIS systems. It supports high-load map services, integration with external systems, and API-based extension for custom applications.
name: ORBISMap
mf-geoadmin3
description: mf-geoadmin3 is the open-source map viewer originally developed for map.geo.admin.ch by the Swiss Federal Office of Topography (swisstopo). Cantonal forks reuse the geoadmin3 frontend, layersConfig APIs, and Cesium/3D viewer stack.

name: Geometa
description: Geometa is a geospatial platform from Gems Development for urban planning, document workflows, and public GIS OGD geoportals. The Agate module publishes planning documents and map layers on official regional portals, typically under /agate_ paths.

name: ArcGIS Instant Apps
description: ArcGIS Instant Apps is Esri's template-based public map app (Basic, Sidebar, Lookup, Filter Gallery, Minimalist, and related templates). Public catalogs are at /apps/instant/{template}/index.html?appid= on *.maps.arcgis.com or Portal for ArcGIS. Distinct from ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (webappbuilder), ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), and ArcGIS Server REST (arcgisserver).

name: CARTO
description: CARTO is a cloud-native spatial analytics and mapping platform for building geospatial data pipelines, running SQL-based geospatial analysis, and publishing interactive maps and location intelligence applications. It integrates with modern cloud data warehouses, supports enterprise governance, and provides APIs and developer tooling for data-driven geo applications.

name: GISPLAN
description: GISPLAN is T-MAPY's municipal web GIS (Spinbox / T-WIST gallery). Slovak tenants usually live at {city}.gisplan.sk or a city host that still loads tmapy.svg / Spinbox and public /mapa/ apps. Czech GIS4U tenants live at {muni}.gis4u.cz; T-WIST galleries also live at {city}.tmapserver.cz and on city hosts that load ost/filebox/ug_hm.php with t-wist_ren / tmapy.svg icons. Distinct from T-MAPY mOBEC (mobec) on mobec.sk tenants, Romanian GISApp (gisapp), Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina), Geoportál GEPRO (gepro), TopGis GisOnline (gisonline), Mapotip (mapotip), and CORA GEO CG WebGIS (cgwebgis). Login-only tenants without a public app gallery are not catalogs.

name: MapTiler Server
description: MapTiler Server is self-hosted software for publishing vector and raster map tiles, styles, and OGC services from an on-premises catalog. It exposes a public map list UI plus REST, WMTS, WMS, TileJSON, and OGC API — Tiles endpoints, typically on port 3650 or behind a reverse proxy.

name: STAC Browser
description: STAC Browser is an open-source web application for browsing SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) static catalogs and STAC APIs. It provides collection and item navigation, map previews, metadata inspection, and asset download links for STAC metadata.

name: GDi Visios
description: GDi Visios is the Web GIS viewer in the GDi Ensemble (formerly LOCALIS) suite. Public apps use path /visios/{app} or /Visios/{tenant}, title GDi Visios, and scripts from VisiosAPI/gdi_js. Used by Croatian cities and counties on their own hosts or on ensmartportal.gdi.net and localismarket.gdi.net. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub on other gdi.net hosts.

name: Micka
description: Micka is an open-source geospatial metadata catalogue for ISO, OGC, and INSPIRE records. It provides a metadata editor, OGC CSW 2.0.2, GeoDCAT/ATOM exports, and INSPIRE ATOM download services used by Czech and other public geoportals.

name: NetGIS Runtime
description: NetGIS Runtime is WSP Danmark's municipal WebGIS viewer. Public maps live at municipal hosts under /NetGISRuntime/basis/index.jsp (often with custid or alias query params) and title NetGIS - © WSP Danmark. Distinct from Turkish Netcad NetGIS Server (netgisserver) and from German netgis.de MapServer clients. One record per municipal viewer, not the ArcGIS REST directory on the same commune.

name: KOVGIS EVALD
description: KOVGIS EVALD is EOMAP / Geodata Arendus municipal web GIS for Estonian local governments. Public tenants live at evald.ee/{slug}/ (service.eomap.ee/{slug}/ redirects there) and expose planning, geoarchive, municipal land, and thematic layers. Distinct from ArcGIS Enterprise gis.{muni}.ee portals, Geoveeb survey archives, and login-only GeoBaas.

Esri Geoportal Server is a metadata catalog platform for discovering and sharing geospatial resources across organizations. It supports standards-based cataloging and federated search, including CSW and OpenSearch interfaces, and can index metadata records from multiple systems for spatial data infrastructure and open data discovery workflows.
name: Esri Geoportal Server
EnviMAP
description: EnviMAP is Envirosense Hungary's municipal zoning-plan GIS. Public tenants include {city}.envimap.hu (Fót EnviMAP SPA, Debrecen GeoForte) and InterMap GeoForte viewers at /hu/Admin/GeoForte/GeoEdit (Dunakeszi on intermap.hu). Distinct from Autodesk MapGuide (Érd) and from old MapFish viewers (Újbuda).

name: MapBiomas
description: MapBiomas is a land-cover mapping and geospatial data platform used to publish annual land-use collections, map viewers, and downloadable geospatial products. Country deployments such as Brazil and Indonesia share the same MapBiomas web application.

name: ArcGIS Experience Builder
description: ArcGIS Experience Builder is Esri's configurable web app for maps and data-driven pages. Public catalogs are hosted at experience.arcgis.com/experience/{id}, on Portal for ArcGIS at /portal/apps/experiencebuilder/experience/?id=, or on a custom domain that loads jimu-core/init.js (title Experience, favicon exb.ico). Swedish Länsstyrelsen WebbGIS tenants on ext-webbgis.lansstyrelsen.se are this product. Distinct from ArcGIS Hub (arcgishub), ArcGIS Server REST (arcgisserver), ArcGIS Web AppBuilder (webappbuilder), ArcGIS Instant Apps (instantapps), and Esri Finland dmCity (dmcity).

name: GeoServer
description: GeoServer is an open-source geospatial server for publishing and managing vector and raster data through OGC standards and REST APIs. It enables organizations to serve interoperable map and feature services (WMS, WFS, WCS, WMTS), style layers with SLD, transform and export data in multiple formats, and build spatial data infrastructures and open-data geoportals.

name: XY Maps
description: XY Maps is Eckersall municipal GIS (XY • MAPS). Public cloud tenants live at maps.xymaps.com/{city} (www.xymaps.com is the same app); city-hosted viewers use /xymaps/Map. HTML title City Maps powered by XY MAPS or Welcome to XY MAPS; /Content/themes/themesAll/xymaps.css. Distinct from Geocortex and ArcGIS viewers Eckersall also builds. Do not register the marketing homepage, staff login, or private floorplan dumps.

name: GC Navi
description: GC Navi is Informatix's public WebGIS (GeoCloud / GeoConic) for Japanese local governments. Cloud tenants are commonly hosted on {organization}.geocloud.jp/webgis/ with bt/p query parameters. The product is distinct from the internal GC Planets integrated GIS.

Rasdaman is an array database and geospatial analytics platform for managing and processing multi-dimensional raster data via OGC-compliant web services. It is used for scalable Earth observation and scientific data infrastructures.
name: Rasdaman
mOBEC
description: mOBEC is T-MAPY's municipal map portal for smaller Slovak towns and villages. Public tenants live at mobec.sk/{slug} (optional hash-base path), load /img/tmapyn.svg, set a numeric tenant ido, and title the public map Všeobecná mapa. Distinct from GISPLAN Spinbox galleries (gisplan) on {city}.gisplan.sk. Staff login chrome on the same SPA does not make the public map a non-catalog.

name: GISApp
description: GISApp is Fida Solutions / Urbanova municipal GIS used by Romanian cities. Tenants live at {city}.gisapp.ro and on city-owned hosts (gis.primaria*.ro, urbanism.*) that show PortalPublic UI and logo_fida.png. ArcGIS REST on webadaptor.gisapp.ro stays arcgisserver. Distinct from Kaliopa iObčina (iobcina) and from EQWC despite the shared gisapp path name.

name: dmCity
description: dmCity is Esri Finland's municipal digital-city SaaS. Public map tenants live at web.dmcity.fi/{city}/public/ with title dmCity Web App and jimu-core/init.js (Experience Builder shell). Distinct from generic ArcGIS Experience Builder (experiencebuilder) on other hosts and from ArcGIS Server REST on {city}.dmcity.fi/server (arcgisserver). One record per public city tenant, not the marketing site.

PopGIS is a geospatial data portal platform used by Pacific institutions to publish and access maps, layers, and related geographic information through web mapping interfaces and interoperable geospatial services.
name: PopGIS
Exponare
description: Exponare is MapInfo / Pitney Bowes (now Precisely) municipal web GIS, the predecessor to Spectrum Spatial Analyst. Public sites use /exponare/RestPublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/PublicApplication.aspx, /exponare/publicinvoker.aspx, or a council mapping.aspx wrapper that still loads Exponare. Distinct from Spectrum Spatial Analyst (/connect/analyst/), IntraMaps, and ArcGIS Hub/REST on the same owner.

GC2 (GeoCloud 2) is an open-source spatial-data platform from MapCentia, often paired with the Vidi browser GIS client. It deploys PostGIS, MapServer or QGIS Server, MapCache, and Elasticsearch, and exposes layers through a SQL API, WMS, WFS, and WMTS. Danish municipalities commonly host tenants on mapcentia.com or gc2.io.
name: GC2
myCarta
description: myCarta WebMap is Aveki's municipal web GIS for Swedish kommuner. Public maps use title myCarta WebMap with meta "a client map application from Aveki AB", path /webmap/ or /mycartawebmap/, or older js/emap.js. Distinct from Hajk (hajk) on other Swedish karta.* hosts. Skip login-only myCarta GO and the Aveki marketing site.

name: MuniSight
description: MuniSight (Catalis GIS WebMap) is a Canadian municipal GIS SaaS. Public tenants live at web.munisight.com/{Tenant} and share Login.aspx, App_Themes/Catalis, and CloudFront JS 3.9.x. Distinct from MRF Web Map (mrf), GIS Cloud (giscloud), and generic Hexagon GeoMedia WebMap (geomediawebmap) Geospatial Portal paths. Do not register the marketing homepage. Staff login walls are still the same product.

name: eLiteGIS
description: eLiteGIS is a server-based platform for building geographic information system (GIS) solutions, GIS portals, and spatial data infrastructures. It provides REST API services compatible with ArcGIS Server protocols and is commonly used with CoGIS to support online and offline map workflows.

name: InGeo
description: InGeo (ГИС ИнГео) is a geospatial platform from CSI Integro for municipal and regional GIS. Desktop InGeo maintains topographic and urban-planning maps; InGeo-Web publishes general plans, land-use rules, and other spatial data as public geoportals.

name: Visor Urbano
description: Visor Urbano is Guadalajara's municipal urban-management GIS, replicated across Mexican cities with Bloomberg Philanthropies support. Public tenants use visorurbano.{city}.gob.mx or {city}.visorurbano.com for cadastral lookup, land-use consultation, and business or construction licences. Distinct from unrelated Leaflet city visors that reuse the "Visor Urbano" label (for example visorguadalupe.com).

name: map.apps
description: map.apps is a commercial WebGIS application framework from con terra for building map viewers and geoportals on top of ArcGIS and OGC services. Public deployments are typically served from a /mapapps/ path.

name: Datacube Open Web Services
description: Datacube Open Web Services (datacube-ows) is an open-source OGC service layer for Open Data Cube deployments. It publishes multidimensional Earth observation datasets through standards-based WMS and WCS endpoints, enabling map visualization and raster data access for analysis workflows. It is maintained by the Open Data Cube community and is commonly used to expose Analysis Ready Data from national and regional datacube infrastructures.

name: geoportal.ch
description: geoportal.ch is a hosted Swiss cantonal geoportal platform. Public tenants share www.geoportal.ch/{canton} (for example ktzg, ktai, ktar) with a common map UI. Distinct from swisstopo mf-geoadmin3 (mfgeoadmin3).

name: GeoMedia WebMap
description: GeoMedia WebMap is Hexagon's (formerly Intergraph) web GIS server for publishing OGC web services and interactive map applications. Public deployments typically expose Geospatial Portal (or GeoMedia WebMap Publisher Portal) as the browser client, often under paths such as /geoportal01/, /cdngiportal/, /msip/Full.aspx, or /Online_Mapping/, with page fingerprints including Version/Build, Licensed to, Intergraph.WebSolutions, and $GP.

name: Mapotip
description: Mapotip is a Czech municipal web map portal for cadastre, DTM, and pasports. Public tenants live at portal.mapotip.cz/{municipality} and load /map/index-*.js with HTML title Mapotip. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan), Geoportál GEPRO (gepro), and TopGis GisOnline (gisonline).

name: MapGuide
description: Autodesk MapGuide Open Source (and MapGuide Enterprise) Web GIS. Public Hungarian CityScape E-GOV viewers load /mapguide/{city}/internet.php or mapviewerphp/ajaxviewer.php. Fusion, OpenLayers, and Arkance/Twigis branding are common on city hosts. Distinct from EnviMAP (envimap) and from old ExtJS MapFish terinfo sites.

name: stac-server
description: stac-server is an open-source STAC API implementation for publishing and querying geospatial metadata and assets. It provides a REST API for STAC catalogs, collections, and item search to support interoperable discovery workflows.

name: NetGIS Server
description: NetGIS Server is a geographic data server from Netcad Yazılım A.Ş. for publishing spatial data as OGC WMS, WFS, WCS, and WMTS services and as web map applications. Version 7 is commonly deployed by Turkish municipalities under a /Netgis7 path, often with a KEOS city-guide viewer as the public UI.

name: mviewer
description: mviewer is an open-source thematic map viewer (OpenLayers and Bootstrap) developed for GéoBretagne and widely reused by French régions, départements, and communes. Applications are configured with XML (apps/*.xml); optional mviewerstudio generates those configs. Distinct from Lizmap and QWC2.

name: GIS Cloud
description: GIS Cloud is a hosted web GIS. Public municipal tenants live at {city}.giscloud.com and load assets.giscloud.com (compiled-smart.js, api.js). Distinct from generic Leaflet viewers and from MuniSight (login-only web.munisight.com). Do not register the marketing homepage or Map Editor login.

name: GisOnline
description: GisOnline is TopGis's municipal web map application. Public city tenants live at app.gisonline.cz/{city} and load app-*.min.js with title “Mapová aplikace GisOnline.cz” and TopGis copyright. Distinct from T-MAPY GISPLAN (gisplan) and Geoportál GEPRO (gepro).

OpenGeoportal is an open-source geoportal platform for discovering, previewing, and accessing geospatial datasets across institutions. It supports federated search and metadata-driven discovery workflows for spatial data infrastructures, with integrations for standards-based geospatial services and export formats used by academic and public-sector data portals.
name: OpenGeoPortal
SIT WebGis
description: SIT WebGis is SIT Servizi di Informazione Territoriale's municipal GIS. Public tenants live at webgis.sit-puglia.it/{comune}/ with title WebGis {Town} (AngularJS ng-app WebApp plus OpenLayers 3 core/lib/openlayers/js/ol.js) or SIT-{TOWN} (Angular CLI plus ol-attribution-hotfix.js). Distinct from Regione Puglia GeoNetwork on repertorio.sit.puglia.it, Lizmap, Spectrum Spatial Analyst, and GeneGIS PAGIS. Do not register the marketing homepage. Skip stale homepage slugs such as /mola and /potenza that 404.

owner.name: SIT Servizi di Informazione Territoriale Srl

name: Wis 2.0 Box
description: WIS2 in a Box (wis2box) is an open-source reference implementation of a WMO WIS2 node for publishing, discovering, and exchanging meteorological and related geospatial data using standards-based web services and messaging.

name: CubeWerx CubeSERV
description: CubeWerx CubeSERV (Stratos Geospatial Platform) is a commercial OGC server for WMS, WMTS, WFS, WCS, CSW, and OGC API. National and provincial SDIs expose it as /cubewerx/cubeserv or a CubeWerx catalogue. Register it when CubeSERV is the public catalog, not merely a backend behind another portal. Distinct from GeoServer (geoserver) and MapServer (mapserver).

name: Geopixel Cidades
description: Geopixel Cidades is a Brazilian municipal geointelligence SaaS (cadastre, IPTU, and public map catalog). Public geoportals use {city}.geoportal.geopixel.com.br, a shared Next.js shell that loads city config from /api/pages. Older tenants also appear at {city}.geopixel.com.br/geopixelcidades-{city}/. The geoportal hostname is a DNS wildcard — do not register a city from HTTP 200 alone.

name: INGRADA online
description: INGRADA online is Softplan Informatik's municipal web GIS. Public BürgerGIS tenants title the page INGRADA online {project}, load /mobile/message-channel.js, and embed Softplan.Ingrada.Mobile with ProductId=IngradaOnline (city host or ingradaweb.org/{city}/online). Distinct from VertiGIS WebOffice (weboffice), MapGuide (mapguide), and generic BürgerGIS landing pages.

name: ActiveMap GIS
description: ActiveMap GIS is a geoinformation platform from Gradoservice that combines web mapping, a desktop layer editor, and mobile apps. It supports map objects on thematic layers, task and work-order workflows, publishing data with access control, offline-capable mobile use, and integrations such as WMS and REST APIs (including Russian municipal portals).

Terria is an open-source geospatial web platform for building interactive map-based data portals. It supports catalog-driven data discovery, visualization of spatial and tabular datasets, and integration with external geospatial services.
name: Terria
Trimble Landfolio
description: Landfolio (formerly FlexiCadastre) is Spatial Dimension's mining and land cadastre platform, now part of Trimble. Public Cadastre Map Portals are often hosted on portals.landfolio.com country tenants. ArcGIS REST services on the same estate stay arcgisserver; this id is for the Landfolio map-portal UI.

name: Evrymap
description: Evrymap is a municipal map portal from Consortis Geospatial. Instances brand the viewer as Evrymap and publish urban-planning and land-use layers over MapServer using OGC WMS, WFS, WMTS, WCS, and CSW.

name: GeoNetwork
description: GeoNetwork is an open-source catalog for discovering and sharing geospatial data and services. It offers search, faceted browsing, metadata editing with ISO 19115/19139 and Dublin Core, publication workflows, harvesting (CSW, OAI-PMH, WFS, and more), OGC CSW and REST APIs, DCAT export, and an interactive map viewer (OpenLayers) for WMS, WMTS, and related services. It is a reference implementation for spatial data infrastructures and is stewarded as an OSGeo project.

name: G3W-SUITE
description: G3W-SUITE is an open-source QGIS WebGIS platform (Django G3W-ADMIN plus Vue/OpenLayers G3W-CLIENT) for publishing QGIS projects as public map catalogs and OGC services. Italian regions, metropolitan cities, parks, and municipalities use it as the public geoportal. Distinct from Lizmap (lizmap) and QWC2 (qwc2).

name: Farvater GIS OGD
description: Farvater GIS OGD is a regional urban-planning information system from Internet-Fregat. It supports GIS OGD document registries, interactive maps via the Farvater GISdoc editor, public portals, and integrations with national spatial-data and public-services platforms.

name: Origo
description: Origo is an open-source OpenLayers web GIS developed by Origosamverkan. Public municipal maps load origo.min.js, origo.js, or Origo configuration JSON, often as named kommun kartan viewers on karta.*.se hosts. Distinct from Hajk (hajk), myCarta (mycarta), and GeoServer backends on the same estate.

name: OVIE
description: OVIE (Oficina Virtual de Información Económica) is INEGI's municipal economic GIS template for IMPLAN and state sites. Public viewers share OpenLayers OL.js, Materialize, html2canvas, canvg, and jsPdf under /js/libs/. Distinct from Mapa Digital de México / MxSIG (mxsig) and from generic OpenLayers copies. Do not set ovie from Mission Viejo geoviewer.io or other hosts that merely contain ovie in the hostname.

name: Hexagon M.App Enterprise
description: Hexagon M.App Enterprise is a commercial geoportal and browser GIS for publishing apps, maps, and OGC services. Public portals often live under /Apps/ with Hexagon Geospatial WMS/WFS. Distinct from GeoMedia WebMap (geomediawebmap) and ERDAS APOLLO (erdasapollo).

name: Pozi
description: Pozi is an Australian-owned web GIS for local government (Groundtruth / Pozi). Public council tenants live at {council}.pozi.com with HTML title Pozi Web Map and a shared CloudFront SPA (assets/entry-app-*.js). Distinct from IntraMaps Public (intramaps), Exponare (exponare), and Spectrum Spatial Analyst (spectrumspatial). Do not register the marketing homepage.

name: Alta Vefsjá
description: Alta Vefsjá is Alta ehf.'s OpenLayers municipal map viewer used for Icelandic planning and local geoportals. Tenants live under geo.alta.is/{tenant}/ and load altacode vefsja assets. The shared GeoServer root at geo.alta.is/geoserver stays software.id geoserver.

name: SIGimWeb
description: Indixio SIGim Web (SIGimWeb) is a Quebec municipal GIS viewer for assessment rolls, graphic matrices, cadastre, and zoning. Public tenants use title SIGimWeb, path /sigimweb/ or /sigim/, ExtJS, and /gomap_web/. Distinct from generic MapGuide (mapguide), GOnet, and JP Cadrin CIF. One record per public MRC or city tenant, not per municipality in the picker.

name: MapServer
description: MapServer is an open-source platform for publishing spatial data and interactive mapping applications through OGC web services. It serves WMS, WFS, WCS, and related protocols from mapfiles, and is widely used as geospatial service middleware in government and research geoportals.

name: EWMAPA
description: EWMAPA is a GIS and geodesy platform used for cadastral, utility, and municipal spatial data management. It supports map publication and geospatial data sharing for local government and surveying workflows, including interoperability through common OGC-style service and exchange formats.

name: ArcGIS Server
description: ArcGIS Server is Esri's on-premises and private-cloud GIS server for publishing maps, feature layers, imagery, and geoprocessing as web services. It provides REST and SOAP endpoints plus OGC interfaces (WMS, WFS, WCS), CSW catalog services, and integrates with ArcGIS Enterprise components such as Portal for ArcGIS for security, licensing, and content management in regulated and air-gapped environments.

name: Bulplan UNIMAP
description: Bulplan UNIMAP is a Bulgarian municipal integrated geoportal used for spatial-planning, property, and support-plan maps. Public tenants live at {municipality}.bulplan.eu.

name: Copernicus DHuS
description: The Data Hub System (DHuS) is ESA's open-source catalog and download platform for Copernicus Sentinel data. National hubs such as ESTHub expose the DHuS web UI at /dhus/. It is distinct from the ECMWF Copernicus Data Stores (CDS).

name: ArcGIS Hub
description: ArcGIS Hub is Esri's cloud-based community engagement platform for sharing open data, maps, and initiatives. Organizations use it with ArcGIS Online to publish branded Hub sites, curate datasets and teams, run goals and initiatives, and engage the public with low-code web experiences. It exposes content through ArcGIS Hub and ArcGIS Online REST APIs, DCAT feeds, and OGC API Records, with governance and licensing options suited to government and enterprise open-data programs.

name: Sitowise Louhi
description: Louhi is Sitowise's municipal geospatial platform. Public karttapalvelu viewers use OpenLayers with Sitowise analytics (snoobi partner=stw) and shared /Scripts/integration/openlayers assets. Distinct from Trimble Locus IMS (trimblelocus), which some Louhi maps may cite as a data source.

name: e-mapa.net
